object: offering table (altar) fragment, about one-third, fine-grained whitish sandstone, Anubis libation scene outlined in the field, inscription round the border
site: Adaye (Sedeinga), necropolis west of the temple (Lepsius); Berlin Inv. 2267
notes: H. 23.5 cm, W. 9 cm; two Lepsius squeezes; L., D., VI, Bl. 7, no. 22; late style. Griffith: '... bye, begotten of Natazakhar' (ntdxr = Natazakhar; Tr[ikelo] = terikelo, the end restored by Griffith in brackets). 'In the field are portions probably of the word "born of," and of a terminal formula': not printed in type.
